Genuinely mystified as to how good this was
Aug 2024 • Family
I mean in Nha Trang you simply do not expect authentic Mexican food and flavours. And yet somehow Cactus delivered beyond wildest expectations.

Every dish we tried (and we tried a lot between the 6 of us) was outstanding with true Mexican touches. Frankly as soon as we saw the proper hot tortilla chips we knew this was going to be far better than the average tex mex place.

Vietnamese staff were very sweet and friendly. Decor is fun with a great upstairs toilet. Value was incredibly. Cocktails were well made.

Slightly tricky to find as it’s on a side alley off the main road - but persist because this place is top notch! Far, far better than almost any Mexican back home in London.
